# Unoccupied Space

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Movement](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#UnoccupiedSpace)*

A space is unoccupied if no creatures are in it and it isn't completely filled by objects.
